source_issue.title: Blicca template separation analysis and follow up

summary_markdown:
```markdown
## What this issue is about
This issue involves analyzing and proposing changes for the separation of template logic in the Plone application, specifically relating to `plone.app.dexterity` and `plone.app.layout`. The goal is to optimize how the REST API interacts with content types after recent structural changes.

## What needs to be done
The main task is to split type management into an API (core) and UI (Blicca, `plone.app.layout`). This involves creating a new module in `plone.app.dexterity` with functions like `create_type` and `delete_type`, and ensuring that the `plone.restapi` code utilizes this new API. Additionally, any remaining backward compatibility issues related to Plone 6.2 need addressing.

## Helpful background
The issue stems from a recent move of certain views and components from `plone.app.dexterity` to `plone.app.layout`, which introduced dependencies that weren't previously declared. Understanding the roles of `TypeSettingsAdapter`, `ITypeSettings`, and other elements is essential for contributing effectively.

## Good first steps
1. Familiarize yourself with the impacted modules: `plone.app.dexterity`, `plone.app.layout`, and `plone.restapi`.
2. Review the proposed functions for the new API in `plone.app.dexterity`.
3. Start discussions on module naming and compatibility concerns in ongoing threads to gather insights.
4. Consider contributing to related PRs when they arise, focused on the outlined changes and testing requirements.
```
